title: melaleuca cylindrica
intro: Melaleuca cylindrica, commonly known as the "Niau" or "Cotton Bush", is a plant species that belongs to the myrtle family and is native to the Pacific Islands. The plant has been traditionally used for its various health benefits, including reducing inflammation and relieving pain, and has been found to have antimicrobial, antioxidant, and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Melaleuca cylindrica include its ability to soothe skin irritations, reduce fever, and aid in wound healing. The bioactive constituents of the plant include terpenoids, flavonoids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
